question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Acquiring**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"acquiring"** means the process of gaining possession or control of something, often through effort or purchase. (अर्जित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She is acquiring new skills to advance her career.
 
 
 
• 
 
The word "acquiring" serves as a **gerund**. A gerund is a **verb **form that ends in "-ing" and functions as a noun in a sentence.

 
 
• 
 
In this sentence, "acquiring" is the **subject**. It refers to the action of gaining proficiency in a second language.

 
 
• 
 
Since gerunds act as nouns, "acquiring" performs the role of the subject, making the action of gaining proficiency the main focus of the clause.

 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct form of the verb to fit in the sentence is **'acquiring'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Acquiring**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Acquires** (अर्जित करता है): Refers to the act of coming into possession of something, in present tense.

 
 
• **Example:** She acquires new books every month.
 
 
 
• **Acquire** (अर्जित करना): Refers to the act of coming into possession of something, usually through effort or experience.
 
 
• **Example: **He plans to acquire a new property in the city.
 
 
 
• **Acquired** (अर्जित किया): Refers to something that has been obtained, usually in the past.
 
 
• **Example:** She acquired the painting from an art gallery.
